summary: Entra Policy Suite Pro arrives with a self-renewing licence and four Pro features, while Community keeps everything it has.

new.title: Pro and the trial
new.text: Entra Policy Suite Pro and a trial come alongside Community, which keeps every feature it has today. Pro installs from a package Invardia signs.

new.title: The licence arrives and renews itself
new.text: A Pro installation requests, checks and stores its licence, and renews it before it ends. Nobody pastes or uploads a licence.

new.title: New License page
new.text: Administration > License shows your edition, who it is for, how long it is valid, users against the licence and which Pro features it switches on.

new.title: Passkey rollout and Stale identities (Pro)
new.text: Passkey rollout tracks, per persona, who can sign in with a passkey against a target date. Stale identities lists inactive accounts and disables them only after a SuperAdmin approves.

new.title: License optimization and Policy as code (Pro)
new.text: License optimization prices the licences you could save on, without changing any. Policy as code puts your policies in Git for review and applies only what you pick.
